scope: All 58 lot-labelled result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 438 grid for the 15 May 2006 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the date, states a total of 58 lots across 3 catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile to the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes 58 distinct lot labels exactly once and reports Offered: 58. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all 58 lot labels appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 58 and the secondary Offered: 58 denominator
